insurer_name: Tata AIG General Insurance Company Limited
sub_limits_waiting_notes: Critical Illness: 90-day waiting + 30-day survival period. Sickness hospitalization: 90-day waiting. Accident hospitalization: no waiting. PED covered after 4 consecutive years on Wellsurance with us.

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Hospital Cash benefit (fixed amount per day) on hospitalization
inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Benefit-based; not indemnity. Pays per-day fixed amount for hospitalization due to sickness or accident.

maternity_coverage.notes: Pregnancy and related conditions excluded (ectopic pregnancy with life-threatening certification allowed).

organ_donor_expenses.notes: Surgery for donation of organs excluded.

critical_illness_cover.limit_text: Fixed lump-sum on diagnosis of listed Critical Illness (without need for hospitalization)
critical_illness_cover.notes: Not available for children covered under the policy. Child benefits reduced by 50%.

disease_wise_sub_limits.child_education_benefit: Lump-sum on death/permanent disability of primary insured
disease_wise_sub_limits.value_added_services: Free Health Helpline, Health Portal, Health & Wellness Discounts

permanent_exclusions: Pre-Existing Condition (unless 4 consecutive years on Wellsurance with us)
Cosmetic/plastic surgery, elective surgery, circumcision (except accidental)
Routine health checks / convalescence (separate from benefit) / debility / rest cure
Pregnancy / Fertility / Birth control (except life-threatening ectopic)
Spectacles, contact lenses, hearing aids, walkers, crutches, wheelchairs
temporary_exclusions: Initial 90 days: Critical Illness + sickness hospitalization
Survival period: 30 days post CI diagnosis
notable_exclusions_summary: Wellness + CI + Hospital Cash benefit plan (no indemnity). Lump-sum on diagnosis of listed CIs (without hospitalization) plus daily hospital cash and convalescence/child education benefits. Excludes AYUSH, maternity, organ donation.
claim_process_summary: Notify within 48 hrs of planned event / 24 hrs of emergency. Toll-free 1800 266 7780 (senior citizens 1800 22 9966).
